plugins.name: Epic Games
plugins.description: Sync your Epic Games Store library to Otix. Auto-import owned games, track playtime, and get notified about free weekly games.
plugins.author: Diogo da Silva

plugins.name: Radarr
plugins.description: Sync an Otix list with multiple Radarr instances. Add movies to your watchlist and they auto-download with full quality profile and root folder configuration.
plugins.author: Diogo da Silva

plugins.name: Sonarr
plugins.description: Sync an Otix list with multiple Sonarr instances. Add TV shows to your watchlist and they auto-download with full quality profile and root folder configuration.
plugins.author: Diogo da Silva

plugins.name: Lidarr
plugins.description: Sync your Otix music library with Lidarr. Add music to your collection and Lidarr will automatically search and download it.
plugins.author: Diogo da Silva

plugins.name: SyncPlay
plugins.description: One-way Spotify → YouTube Music playlist sync. Connect Spotify and Google, map your Spotify playlists to YouTube Music playlists, and keep them in sync automatically.
plugins.author: Otix
